subject: Request: Approval for onboarding fee waiver & expanded premium support (Orchid Health)
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Tanya Singh <tanya@orchidhealth.com>, Ken Morales <ken.morales@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed bundle & onboarding — Orchid Health

Hi Tanya / Ken,

Thanks again for the time last week. Attached is a compact proposal for the bundle we discussed: 12-month Hosted API, Concierge Onboarding (4-week integration), and Premium Support (24/7 priority with a one-hour P0 response SLT).

Key commercial points:
- List price: $420,000 annual contract value (ACV)
- We can offer a one-time onboarding fee of $20,000 (standard is $40,000) — i.e., a $20k waiver — if we commit to a 12-month term and Redwood retains right to publish a neutral case study after 6 months.
- Premium Support included in Year 1, then standard renewal pricing thereafter (see worksheet).

Can you confirm this structure is acceptable to procurement? If you need exec approval for the one-time fee concession, I can route for signoff today. We hope to close before month-end to hit June deployment.

Attachments: Orchid_SOW_draft.pdf, Pricing_Worksheet_RDW-2391.xlsx

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0172

From: Ken Morales <ken.morales@orchidhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:05:14 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed bundle & onboarding — Orchid Health

Irene,

Appreciate the quick turnaround. The package looks good overall. Two asks from procurement/finance: 1) can you confirm there is no additional professional services hourly cap beyond the 4-week onboarding scope (finance wants a not-to-exceed), and 2) the $20k onboarding waiver is higher than our procurement guidelines for a vendor of this size — we need an exec-level approval for any onboarding waiver over $10k.

Also, if Redwood can include a short remediation window in the SOW (30 days for integration support post-launch), that would help expedite legal signoff.

If you can escalate for approval and confirm the NTE and remediation clause, we can move to DocuSign this week.

Thanks,
Ken
Senior PM, Vendor Ops | Orchid Health

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:02:31 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Orchid Health — request for onboarding waiver >$10k & NTE for PS

Marissa — forwarding for quick review and exec signoff.

Summary: AE (Irene) has an active deal (RDW-2391) with Orchid Health for a 12-month hosted + premium support bundle. Customer requests:
- Waive $20k of onboarding fee (we have proposed taking it to $20k from standard $40k). Procurement requires exec approval for any concession >$10k.
- Add Not-to-Exceed cap of $25k on professional services beyond the 4-week onboarding scope and a 30-day remediation support window in the SOW.

Why we should approve:
- Strategic entry into a multi-clinic healthcare customer in our target vertical; reference potential plus product telemetry for ML evals.
- Reasonable revenue expectation for Year 1 and opportunity for expansion (onboarding should reveal multiple integration upsell paths).

Risks / ask: Approve the $20k onboarding waiver (i.e., allow onboarding fee to be $20k) and permit the NTE on PS at $25k. We will require a one-time deferred revenue recognition note to Finance and record the concession in deal desk ticket.

Attachments: Pricing_Worksheet_RDW-2391.xlsx, Orchid_SOW_draft.pdf

Requested action: Marissa — approve or decline with counter. If approved, please CC finance-ops and legal for the SOW amendment and I will prepare the DocuSign envelope.

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Deal Desk Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, finance_ops@redwood.com, legal@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 12:46:50 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Orchid Health — request for onboarding waiver >$10k & NTE for PS

Ben / team,

Approved with conditions. I authorize the $20k onboarding concession for RDW-2391 contingent on the following:
1) Redwood obtains a published customer case study (neutral, 6-month post-launch) or an equivalent written reference from Orchid's VP Product.
2) The Professional Services NTE is capped at $25k, and any PS spend beyond that requires pre-approval from me (email suffice).
3) Finance must sign off on deferred revenue accounting for the waived amount; copy Finance Ops on the DocuSign envelope and mark the concession in the deal record.
4) Legal to incorporate the 30-day remediation window into the SOW and confirm that liability caps remain standard.

Monica — please prepare the onboarding plan and RACI for the 4-week integration; include a 30-day post-launch remediation schedule. Ben — once Finance and Legal confirm, route to DocuSign and finish execution.

Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Ken Morales <ken.morales@orchidhealth.com>, Tanya Singh <tanya@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, finance_ops@redwood.com, legal@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed bundle & onboarding — Orchid Health (approved)

Ken / Tanya — great news: Redwood has approved the onboarding fee reduction to $20k and the PS NTE at $25k, with the standard conditions from legal and finance (see Marissa's note above).

Next steps:
- Legal will update the SOW to include the 30-day remediation window and confirm standard liability language (legal@redwood.com).
- Finance Ops will sign off on deferred revenue treatment for the waived portion (finance_ops@redwood.com).
- Monica will circulate the detailed 4-week onboarding plan by EOD tomorrow.
- I'll prepare the DocuSign envelope and share for countersignature once legal confirms the SOW update.

Target: countersign by Thu 24 Jun to keep June deployment window.

Thanks for the partnership — excited to get Orchid live.

Best,
Irene
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
